notes: Plain-text Form 10-QSB for the quarter ended February 29, 2008, filed as Sea 2 Sky Corporation shortly before small companies moved to Form 10-Q. It keeps the 10-QSB numbering: Part I Item 3 is Controls and Procedures and there is no Part I Item 4. A contents list after the cover names every Item with page numbers and calls Part II Items 1 to 5 'Not Applicable'; each body heading appears once after it, and the body answers those Items 'None', which is an answer, so none is marked incorporated. Item 1 holds F-paged financial statements with their own index and runs to Item 2. Part II Item 2 has the older title 'Changes in Securities and Use of Proceeds'. Part II Item 1A is not listed absent: the form did not have it. Item 6 lists the certification exhibits and ends at SIGNATURES.
